fomus-masu.description_en: A traditional ichigo masu box (180 ml) crafted from Japanese hinoki cypress, branded with the original FOMUS design. Perfect for sake, craft beer, or even tea. The wood's character deepens beautifully the more you use it. Not dishwasher safe — please hand-wash.

fomus-masu-10set.description_en: A set of ten FOMUS masu. Ideal for celebrations, wedding favors, and corporate gifts. Ten ichigo masu (180 ml) crafted from Japanese hinoki cypress. Custom laser engraving available on request (quoted separately).

mini-fomus-masu.description_en: The original FOMUS masu in a compact size — perfect as a sake tasting cup or a small keepsake tray. Enjoy the scent and warmth of Japanese hinoki cypress in the palm of your hand. Custom name engraving also available.

mini-fomus-masu-10set.description_en: A set of ten mini FOMUS masu. Perfect for party favors, event giveaways, and corporate novelties. Ten compact masu crafted from Japanese hinoki cypress.

masu-lid-ichigo.description_en: A special-edition ichigo masu of Japanese hinoki cypress fitted with a lid. Lovely as a keepsake box or a gift box.

masu-lid-mini.description_en: A special-edition mini masu of Japanese hinoki cypress fitted with a lid. Ideal as a jewelry case or an incense holder.

masu-frame.description_en: An original display frame assembled from masu boxes. Price quoted by size and design. From ¥80,000.

masu-tower-100-ichigo.description_en: An art installation of 100 stacked ichigo masu in Japanese hinoki cypress. For events, exhibitions, and corporate displays.

masu-tower-100-mini.description_en: An art installation of 100 stacked mini masu in Japanese hinoki cypress. Compact, yet commanding.

masukame.description_en: An original piece fusing the masu with the turtle — a one-of-a-kind art object built with Japanese hinoki masu craftsmanship.

fomus-running-wear.description_en: Original FOMUS running shirt in vivid blue with Japanese patterns and a JAPAN logo. Quick-dry, sweat-wicking fabric. Available in M and L.

kubi-kake-masu.description_en: An original FOMUS masu you can wear around your neck — a favorite at festivals and events. Pour in sake or any drink and enjoy hands-free.

arabic-masu.description_en: An original FOMUS masu featuring Arabic calligraphy. A symbol of cultural exchange — beautiful as a gift or an interior piece.
